overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet to review financial statements, consider a capital improvements program budget, and evaluate a preliminary plat for the Green Tree Subdivision, along with a closed session discussion regarding police union collective bargaining.

agenda.item: Call Meeting to Order - Pledge of Allegiance and Roll Call
Public Comment (15 minutes total, 3 minutes per person)
Finance Director/Treasurer Report - July 31, 2026 Financial Statements (Budget Status Report)
Update on TID #1 Information from 2026 Equalized Valuation Report - Email Response from Wisconsin Department of Revenue
August 10, 2026 Village Board Meeting Minutes - Consent Agenda
July 2026 Check Register, ACH Register, and Credit Card Transactions Activity - Consent Agenda
2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget - 1st Draft as of 7/31/2026
Green Tree Subdivision Preliminary Plat Review
Closed Session - Negotiation of Collective Bargaining Agreement for Kronenwetter Professional Police Association
Consideration of Items for Future Agenda

discussions.item: Finance Director/Treasurer Report - July 31, 2026 Financial Statements
discussions.body: The board was set to review the village's budget status report as of July 31, 2026, which would provide a financial overview of the current fiscal year's performance and expenditures.

discussions.item: Update on TID #1 Information from 2026 Equalized Valuation Report
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to receive information regarding Tax Increment District #1 based on the 2026 equalized valuation report, including email correspondence from the Wisconsin Department of Revenue regarding this matter.

The board was set to discuss and consider the first draft of the ten-year capital improvements program budget dated July 31, 2026, which would outline planned infrastructure and facility projects for the upcoming decade.

The board was scheduled to review and take possible action on the preliminary plat for the Green Tree Subdivision, a development proposal that was expected to require planning commission input and board consideration.

discussions.item: Kronenwetter Professional Police Association Collective Bargaining Agreement
discussions.body: The board was set to convene in closed session to negotiate and deliberate the collective bargaining agreement with the Kronenwetter Professional Police Association, a personnel matter requiring confidential discussion per state statute.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled for 15 minutes total with a three-minute time limit per person, with possible extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
